value.name: send corrected message
value.description: Asha finishes typing a corrected draft and sends it, waiting for confirmation that the message has gone.
evidence: his name in the signature block lay under the cap of her pen, and she waited the few seconds it took for the small gray tick to confirm the message had gone.

value.name: file draft in briefcase
value.description: Asha tears off the second draft, stacks it with the first, and puts both pages into her briefcase after checking Devin's name in the signature block.
evidence: Asha tore the second draft off the legal pad, set it on top of the first, and squared the edges against the table before sliding both pages into the inner sleeve of her briefcase.
She checked once that Devin's name sat in the signature block where she had written it, then closed the flap and let the latch click.

value.name: ignore unanswered phone
value.description: Asha notices that the message to Devin is still unanswered but deliberately leaves her phone untouched.
evidence: The phone screen was still bright beside her elbow, the message to him delivered and unanswered, and she did not pick it up.

value.name: leave apartment with briefcase
value.description: Asha puts on her coat, takes her briefcase, and heads out of her apartment.
evidence: She lifted her coat off the back of the chair and put it on again, the briefcase already in her hand by the time she reached for the keys.

value.name: descend to garage
value.description: Asha leaves her building and goes down the stairwell to the garage without slowing.
evidence: The stairwell light in her building was still on its night setting when Asha let the door close behind her, and she took the steps down to the garage without slowing.

value.name: drive to Devin's apartment
value.description: Asha drives toward Devin's apartment from memory, carrying the briefcase as if it contains something to be handed over.
evidence: In the car she set the briefcase on the passenger seat with the latch toward her, the way she would have placed a file she meant to hand across a desk, and she pulled out into the street under the sodium lamps.
She drove the route to Devin's apartment by memory, both hands high on the wheel

value.name: inspect briefcase at red light
value.description: Stopped at a red light, Asha looks at the briefcase and recognizes the corrected paragraph inside as she begins to understand the implications of what she has done.
evidence: and at the long red on Spring Garden she let her eyes go to the briefcase and then back to the light.
